main.description: Baseline: gpt-5.6-terra, low reasoning, default risk limits.

luna.description: Same rules and prompt on the cheap model. Does model quality matter?

momentum.style: Style: concentrate. Hold at most four names showing the strongest 20-day relative strength in the watchlist, sized to the cap. Rotate out of a name only when it drops out of the top group or a thesis breaks. Ignore intraday noise.
momentum.description: Concentrated relative-strength: 25% cap, max 4 names, 3 orders per cycle.

cautious.style: Style: capital preservation first. Prefer cash over marginal ideas; only buy when both the daily trend and the news flow support it. Never hold more than 70% invested.
cautious.description: Defensive: 15% cap, 50% sector cap, tighter stops, medium reasoning.
